## Priority: Flag these (real bugs)
- Logic errors, crashes, unhandled exceptions (e.g., None.append(), FK violations)
- Broken file paths, missing imports, wrong dependency versions
- Data corruption (e.g., double-encoding JSON, wrong SQL ON CONFLICT behavior)
- HTML/XSS injection in user-facing output
- Blocking the async event loop (CPU-bound work in async endpoints)

## Low priority: Note but don't block
- Race conditions that only matter with multiple instances (we run one)
- Missing input validation on internal-only endpoints
- Authorization gaps — this runs on a private LAN for family use, not the internet

## Do not flag
- Code style, naming conventions, or type annotation suggestions
- Missing tests, linting, or CI pipeline (acknowledged, future work)
- "Consider using X library/pattern" unless it fixes an actual bug
- Auth hardening (JWT, sessions, tokens) — PIN-based auth is intentional for a family LAN app
- User enumeration concerns — all users are family members on the same network
- Warnings about endpoints trusting client-supplied user_id — no internet exposure

## Context
Personal AI engineering lab on a homelab. Private LAN only, single gateway
instance, family of ~5 users. The goal is learning AI systems, not building
a production SaaS. Keep feedback focused on things that will actually break.
